title: N'Kiyla Thomas
intro:
N'Kiyla Thomas (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. Senate to represent Oklahoma. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the Democratic primary runoff on August 25, 2026.
Thomas completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2025. Click here to read the survey answers.
